description: Update frontend payment flow in src/routes/forms/$slug.tsx to use the corrected pre-payment recording flow. Change record_payment_transaction call to pass submission_id=NULL and form_id (instead of pre-generated submission_id that doesn't exist yet). The submit_response call will link the payment to the submission server-side. This fixes the FK violation bug and completes the payment-first security implementation on the frontend. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: Locate the payment recording loop (lines ~586-620) inside handleSubmit function
Remove submissionId generation from line ~580 - DELETE: const submissionId = uuidv4();
Update record_payment_transaction call (line ~594): Change p_submission_id from submissionId to null, and ADD p_form_id: form.id as the first parameter
Keep the submit_response call (line ~628) - remove p_submission_id parameter entirely (let server generate it, or keep it but the server will use its own generated ID)
Update error message for payment verification failure (line ~652): Change to 'Payment verification failed. Please ensure all required payments are completed before submitting the form.'
Add console logging for debugging: console.log('[payment] Pre-recorded payment for question:', questionId, 'transaction:', txResult); after successful record_payment_transaction
Test the updated flow: payment records with submission_id=NULL, submit_response links it and verifies
acceptance_criteria: Payment recording succeeds without FK violation errors
Form submission succeeds after payment recorded
Dev tools bypass attempt (window.__pendingPayments = {}) shows clear error message about payment verification
No console errors about foreign key constraints during normal flow
Payment flow works end-to-end: Razorpay checkout → record payment → submit form → success
verification: npm run typecheck - no TypeScript errors
npm run dev - start dev server

Manual test 1 (happy path): Create form with payment question (100 INR), open in browser, complete Razorpay test payment (card 4111111111111111), submit form, verify success message and reference ID displayed

Manual test 2 (bypass attempt): Open same form in new incognito tab, open dev console, run: window.__pendingPayments = {}, try to submit without paying, verify error 'Payment verification failed' displayed
Browser console check: No errors about FK violations or database constraints during either test

Database verification after successful payment: SELECT pt.submission_id, pt.verified, s.reference_id FROM payment_transactions pt JOIN submissions s ON pt.submission_id = s.id WHERE pt.razorpay_payment_id = '<test-payment-id>' - should show linked submission
findings: Successfully updated frontend payment flow in src/routes/forms/$slug.tsx. Changes made: (1) Removed pre-generated submissionId via uuidv4() - line 580 deleted. (2) Updated record_payment_transaction RPC call to pass p_form_id: form.id as first parameter and p_submission_id: null instead of pre-generated ID. (3) Removed p_submission_id parameter from submit_response RPC call - server now generates and links submission. (4) Enhanced error message for payment verification failure to be more explicit. (5) Added detailed console logging showing question ID and transaction result after successful payment recording. TypeScript compilation passes with no errors. Frontend now correctly implements the payment-first security flow: payment recorded with NULL submission_id, then submit_response creates submission and links the payment atomically server-side.
